# Layer test fixture

`emptyimage.clip` is the empty canvas template from
[wamsoft/clipparse](https://github.com/wamsoft/clipparse/blob/master/samples/emptyimage.clip),
downloaded 2026-10-22. It is used to generate small synthetic CLIP test documents.
The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSES/clipparse-0.2.0.txt`.
No user artwork is included.
